fragments.source: public MachineWorkModeEnum MachineWorkMode { get; set; } = MachineWorkModeEnum.NormalWork;

observations: Both original start handlers call Machine.Start synchronously and restore Enabled in finally. BarItemStart sets Enabled=false before try, while BtStart sets it inside try; setter faults therefore have distinct catch reachability.
Recipe Cancel returns through finally without docking, mode clearing or Machine.Start; failures after dock/mode mutation do not roll those mutations back.

Original Start callers call full Stop on synchronous exceptions, so the live wafer retained after bare Machine.Start downstream failures must be reevaluated through the real callers. Inner normal-return failures bypass this catch.

Both start handlers write IsSingleStepWork=false then set the checked toggle false; original checked-change callback can publish System2SingleStepSignal. Actual reset omits this event; SDK event-dispatch semantics must remain explicit.

Work-mode change unboxes EditValue into MachineWorkModeEnum without a state guard or catch. Original offline/dry/compensation/normal predicates derive from this single enum rather than independent test booleans.
Full TransportTask.Start still needs its complete producer and real outer transfer integration; the compiled isolated guard/delegate suites retain narrower scope.
